lexicalDispositions.decision: Selected necessary new support 僧侶 そうりょ, Buddhist noun sense. One spelling/reading, no spelling/reading/sense restrictions. No existing article; no vocabulary level inferred. Individual or collective reference does not force plural translation.

Standalone 僧, 高僧, 禅僧 and 僧院 corroborate the monk/priest and institutional range. 僧 has a separate abbreviated sangha sense. Optional kana-supplied breadth, not four necessary new support articles or a frequency ranking.

Small-boy, apprentice, figurative, anatomical kneecap, proverb, folklore, character-name and other 小僧/若僧 families are not interchangeable with the selected Buddhist-clergy noun. 小僧 has separate boy, young-monk and shop-boy senses. Keep actual derogatory/proverb/character flags local to their senses. Compound ぞう does not add ゾウ to the sole frozen 僧 on-reading or license pronouncing 僧侶 as ぞうりょ.

仏法僧: the Buddhist Three Jewels sense is restricted to the reading ぶっぽうそう; that reading is not itself restricted to that sense. Katakana ブッポウソウ is re_nokanji. Bird senses and their kana-use flags are distinct. Not a new support article or a blanket Buddhist interpretation of every spelling occurrence.
凡僧 offers ぼんそう and ぼんぞう for the ordinary/unranked priest sense; the foolish-monk sense is restricted to ぼんそう. Preserve exact sense-reading restriction, not unrestricted variant substitution.

声の仏法僧/声のブッポウソウ has two exact spelling-reading restrictions and a rare-term bird sense. 西仏法僧 has a kana-only katakana reading and usually-kana bird sense. Not evidence of Buddhist clerical usage or new character readings.

尼僧 has Buddhist-nun and Catholic-nun senses; 尼僧院 nunnery/convent, 修道僧 monk/friar, 軍僧 chaplain and 聴聞僧 confessor preserve wider religious uses. Do not write an absolute all-僧-compounds-are-Buddhist rule. None is needed as another support article.
Both 僧家 そうか/そうけ senses are rare-term flagged: temple and priest. No priority/modern-frequency inference and no additional support article.
貴僧 has an honorific/respectful flag. Not the neutral model for every monk or proof of a compulsory clerical rank.
愚僧 has separate foolish-monk noun and humble monk's I/me pronoun senses; 拙僧 is a humble pronoun. Preserve speaker role, sense and register; do not teach as neutral third-person substitutes for 僧侶.
僧綱 and 護持僧/御持僧 carry historical-term flags. Retain historical official/ritual senses without turning them into a modern office or neutral support example.

僧供, 我僧/和僧, 声聞僧, 薦僧/菰僧, 車僧 and 売僧 retain their exact archaic/familiar/derogatory flags. 我僧 is a vocative; 売僧 まいす has derogatory corrupt-monk senses and a separate archaic liar sense. Do not infer per-character まいす, modern neutrality or commonness.

蛮僧/蕃僧 is rare-term flagged; ラマ僧/喇嘛僧 has a rarely-used kanji-form flag only on 喇嘛僧. Do not transfer a spelling flag to the spoken reading, or treat absence of a register flag as proof of universal preferred address.
僧帽弁, 僧帽筋 and 僧帽弁閉鎖不全 are anatomical/medical terms; 密陀僧 is a chemistry term. Not religious-role synonyms or necessary support words.

Retain priests/laypeople, monks/nuns, community, collective-priest, monastery and borrowed numerical families separately. 僧衆 and 僧伽藍摩 have alternate whole-word readings; 阿僧祇 is not evidence that every 僧 means a person. None requires new practice keys or support cards.

Remaining inspected clerical-role, rank, clothing, location, activity and related lexical families are preserved completely for their own exact senses. No additional necessary support identity or source reading was established. Not selected for new articles; absence of a priority/register flag is not a frequency or neutrality claim. No unrestricted substitution or historical derivation is inferred.
